decisions.reason: Close to the established offer and with industry slack, it likely meets aspirations through existing technical and customer fit, so withdrawal risk is low.
Building on established capabilities and serving core customers, it likely performs at or above aspirations, so slack supports keeping it.
Distant from the core offer and lacking evidence of market success, it likely falls below aspirations, triggering problemistic search and resource redeployment.
A distant product line with uncertain fit to existing customers likely underperforms relative to aspirations, so management drops it to redirect resources.
Very distant from core pipeline fabrication and without demonstrated demand, it is below aspiration and problemistic search favors withdrawal.
